'''This [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]''' seemed to frequent [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]], and was present when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] visited the bar in search of information. At that time, the Nikto stood watching a Bith sitting near him. Soon after, however, the Nikto became bored, and drifted away toward a [[Unidentified Quarren 2 (Moshi Bar)|Quarren]]. By that time, Ahsoka had begun [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to listen in on people's conversations in the hopes of picking up on the whereabouts of a [[Aurra Sing/Legends|dangerous]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. The first conversation she heard was between this Nikto and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] he had recently encountered. The Quarren owned a business, and due to [[Clone Wars/Legends|the war]], it was doing poorly. All this was told to an extremely distracted Nikto, who turned slightly to let out a subtle grunt before the Quarren had finished his sentence. When a fight broke out between the Jedi and the patrons of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], the Nikto, along with the other patrons, soon became distracted from [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]] thrown by one of the Jedi.
